physical_mismatches.reason: The original scenario is a 3D layered chip (129x129x7 mesh) with a device layer and substrate. A 2D or single-layer model cannot reproduce the vertical conduction and substrate Robin cooling path.
The original is a transient simulation (3 ms) with pulsed power (3.333 us period, averaged over 10k cycles at 3 GHz). A steady-state model would not match the reported dynamic temperature at unit C.

The original solver is a FEniCS FEM DNS and a POD-Galerkin reduced-order model with a data-driven mode basis. A Studio solver differs in discretization and cannot reproduce the 1/3/5-mode ROM comparison.

The original boundary conditions are adiabatic on the sides and top and Robin at the substrate bottom with 0 C ambient. No package, heat sink, interposer or realistic cooling stack is modeled, and the Robin coefficient is not given.
The paper has no controller, optimizer, reliability analysis or 2.5D/3D integration study. Any Studio controller or optimizer would be an addition outside the original scenario.
